title: Project progress auto-calculation service
description: Create a service that recalculates and persists project progress whenever todos are added, completed, or unchecked. Progress = (completed_todos / total_todos) * 100, clamped to 0-100.
acceptanceCriteria: recalculateProgress(projectId) function exists in a service file
Returns 0 if project has no todos
Correctly calculates percentage from completed vs total todos
Logs a progress_change timeline event if progress changed by >= 5%
Called automatically when todos are created, completed, or deleted

steps.details: Create server/src/services/progressService.ts. Export async function recalculateProgress(projectId: string): Promise<number>. Query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN is_completed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as done FROM todos WHERE project_id = projectId. Compute pct = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((done / total) * 100). Update projects.progress_auto = pct WHERE id = projectId. Return pct.

steps.description: Add timeline event on significant progress change
steps.details: Before updating, fetch current progress_auto. If abs(newPct - oldPct) >= 5, call logTimelineEvent(projectId, 'progress_change', { from: oldPct, to: newPct, isManual: false }). This avoids spamming the timeline on every tiny change.
Call recalculateProgress(projectId) after: creating a todo, toggling todo completion, deleting a todo. These calls happen in the todo route handlers (TASK-38, TASK-40, TASK-41).
Create a project with 4 todos. Complete 2 — verify progress_auto = 50. Complete the other 2 — verify 100. Uncheck one — verify 75.
